verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no option for choosing a data storage region or residency. It only says prompts and responses are stored on xAI's servers. The business-workspace 'enterprise-grade privacy protections' is an adjacent privacy feature, not a region selection. Data residency is a fair axis for an AI SaaS/API product, so the absence of evidence yields 'none' rather than 'na'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
